classification.difficultyReason: Construct SAS similarity proofs, preserve corresponding vertex order and determine directed scale factors.

content.prompt: Prove that the two triangles in each diagram are similar, and write the similarity statement and the similarity factor (left to right).

spec.description: Paired upright isosceles triangles; single equal-side ticks and included angle labels. Decorative source blue becomes black.
spec.mathematics: AB=AC=5 cm, PQ=PR=7 cm, angle BAC=angle QPR=30 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no similarity conclusion or scale factor.

answer.worked:
$PQ=PR=7\text{ cm}$ (equal-side marks).

$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB}{PQ}&=\frac57\\\frac{AC}{PR}&=\frac57\\\angle BAC&=\angle QPR=30^\circ\end{align*}$$
Thus $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle PQR$ (SAS).

The similarity factor from left to right is $\frac{PQ}{AB}=\frac75$.

spec.description: Separate left and right triangles both labelled ABC, with identical printed measurements. Source label duplication is preserved.
spec.mathematics: Each triangle has AB=6, AC=12 and angle BAC=50 degrees.

answer.worked:
Comparing the left triangle with the right triangle:

$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB\text{ (left)}}{AB\text{ (right)}}&=\frac66=1\\\frac{AC\text{ (left)}}{AC\text{ (right)}}&=\frac{12}{12}=1\\\angle BAC\text{ (left)}&=\angle BAC\text{ (right)}=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
Thus $\triangle ABC$ (left) $\sim\triangle ABC$ (right) (SAS).

The similarity factor from left to right is $1$.

spec.description: Paired obtuse triangles with horizontal lower sides and upper vertices to the right; right triangle is half the linear size.
spec.mathematics: AB=2, BC=8, PQ=1, QR=4; included angles at B and Q are 120 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB}{PQ}&=\frac21=2\\\frac{BC}{QR}&=\frac84=2\\\angle ABC&=\angle PQR=120^\circ\end{align*}$$
Thus $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle PQR$ (SAS).

The similarity factor from left to right is $\frac{PQ}{AB}=\frac12$.

spec.description: Paired upright triangles with included top angles. As in the source, their displayed sizes do not represent their numerical scale factor.
spec.mathematics: AB=10, AC=9, PQ=2, PR=1.8; included angles at A and P are 40 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AB}{PQ}&=\frac{10}{2}=5\\\frac{AC}{PR}&=\frac{9}{1.8}=5\\\angle BAC&=\angle QPR=40^\circ\end{align*}$$
Thus $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle PQR$ (SAS).

The similarity factor from left to right is $\frac{PQ}{AB}=\frac15$.
